Raise `ValueError` for malformed headers, duplicate sections, assignments before a header, significant lines without `=`, or empty keys. Validate the complete input before returning. import unittest

from solution import parse_sections


class ParseSectionsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parsing_order_replacement_comments_and_blanks(self):
        lines = [
            "  # ignored", "", " [first] ", " a = one ", "b=", "a=two",
            "\t# ignored too", "[second]", " x = y=z ",
        ]
        original = lines[:]
        result = parse_sections(lines)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"name": "first", "values": {"a": "two", "b": ""}},
            {"name": "second", "values": {"x": "y=z"}},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(list(result[0]["values"]), ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(lines, original)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], result[1])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["values"], result[1]["values"])

    def test_empty_comment_only_and_iterator(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_sections([]), [])
        self.assertEqual(parse_sections(iter([" ", "# x", " \t # y"])), [])

    def test_container_and_element_types(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            parse_sections(None)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            parse_sections(["[ok]", 3])

    def test_malformed_headers_and_duplicate_sections(self):
        for line in ["[]", "[ name]", "[name ]", "[a] trailing", "[[a]]"]:
            with self.subTest(line=line):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_sections([line])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_sections(["[a]", "x=1", "[a]"])

    def test_assignment_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_sections(["x=1", "[later]"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_sections(["[a]", "not an assignment"])
        for line in ["=value", "   = value"]:
            with self.subTest(line=line):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_sections(["[a]", line])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
